subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should this PR expose `inputProvenance` through the public `AgentSession.steer` options overload while rebasing over current main's reply-run queue contract?
rationale: The bug-fix direction is plausible, but the branch is currently dirty and the API surface change is public through the plugin SDK barrel, so automation should not choose the permanent contract shape alone.

options.title: Rebase and preserve current queue contract
options.body: Accept the narrow provenance direction after rebasing over current main while retaining `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` and full queue-option forwarding.

options.title: Keep provenance plumbing internal
options.body: Ask for a revision that avoids exporting a new public steer options type if maintainers do not want this plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave this PR open but unmergeable until the linked subagent/session-state direction is resolved by a broader owner-led change.

recommendation.title: Rebase and preserve current queue contract
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow provenance direction after rebasing over current main while retaining `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` and full queue-option forwarding.
